props.name: value
props.description: A number for one thumb, an array for a range with a thumb per entry.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change, while dragging too. `value` is a number or an array, as `value`/`defaultValue` is.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: When a change is final: on pointer release, and on each key press.

props.name: step
props.description: The values are multiples of `step` from `min`. Default 1.

props.name: minStepsBetweenValues
props.description: How many steps apart a range's thumbs must stay. Default 0.

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot), each thumb's range input submits its value with the form.

props.name: format
props.description: How SliderValue shows the values and the thumbs announce them.

parts.name: SliderControl
parts.description: The area that takes pointer presses: a press moves the nearest thumb there, then dragging moves it. Thumbs must be inside it.

parts.name: SliderTrack
parts.description: The rail the thumbs move along: they and the indicator are positioned within it (`position: relative`).

parts.name: SliderIndicator
parts.description: The filled part of the track: from the start to the value, or between a range's first and last thumbs.

parts.name: SliderValue
parts.description: The values, formatted (a range's joined with " – "), as an <output> for the thumbs' inputs. Not announced while it changes (`aria-live="off"`): the focused thumb announces its own value.

parts.name: SliderThumb
parts.description: The thumb is a positioned <div> around a visually hidden <input type="range">, which is what takes focus, carries the slider ARIA and submits the value. `index` picks the thumb's value.

props.name: index
props.description: Which value this thumb shows: 0 for a single-value slider, its position in the array for a range.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.type: (formattedValue: string, value: number, index: number) => string
props.default: the formatted value with a `format`; for a two-thumb range, "<value> start range" and "<value> end range"
props.description: The input's announced value, from the formatted value, the value and the thumb's index.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-index
dataAttributes.description: The part's index among its siblings.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.
